Basic audio transcription

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.createTranscriptionRequestFromJson("{\"file\":\"audio.mp3\",\"model\":\"whisper-1\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.transcribe(request: _request)
debugPrint(result.text)
```
